title: Tere Ishq Mein
description: A heartfelt bilingual track about the lingering presence of love, gratitude, and finding a place to belong.
lyricFragments: Tum ho toh sab hai / Tum na ho toh na hi kuch hai
Main tere ishq mein khoya rahun
lyricContext: The bridge shifts into English to reflect on early love and family, grounding the romance in something deeply personal.
story: I was people-watching one evening and noticed a boy and a girl sitting together in complete, comfortable silence. They weren't talking, just existing in each other's space, totally lost in their own world. It sparked the thought: 'Tum ho toh sab hai'. That simple observation made me reflect on my own life. For a long time, the only unconditional love I truly understood was from my mother and my brother. Seeing the quiet certainty of that couple inspired me to write about the kind of love that suddenly enters your life and completely rewrites your understanding of the world.
storyPlace: A quiet evening at Juhu Beach
